In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the religious orders in Peru were victims of the same forces of change that affected all of the colonial society.
the orders were victims of the times, of a new era in the history of Peru.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the religious orders were the victims of the new political order in the country, and that their demise was the result of the new government’s need to establish itself as the dominant force in the country.
the orders had been the victims of a combination of forces.
the religious orders were a victim of the political and economic turmoil which engulfed the country in the 1820s.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the religious orders in Peru were not destroyed because of the secularizing tendencies of the new republic or the anti-clericalism of its citizens.
the religious orders were the first victims of the new state.
the religious orders were not the victims of a conspiracy, as they have claimed, but rather the victims of a political struggle.
